secondary_keywords: app store conversion rate by category

facts.claim: Average app store page conversion is 30.3% on iOS and 33% on Google Play, an order of magnitude above impression-based rates
facts.source_title: App store conversion rate: how to improve it, with benchmarks
facts.excerpt: The benchmark for app store conversion rates is, on average, 30.3% on iOS and 33% on Google Play.

facts.claim: Store conversion by category spans social networking at 10% to 20% on iOS up to utilities at 30% to 40%
facts.source_title: App store conversion rate: how to improve it, with benchmarks
facts.excerpt: Games 25-35% iOS, Utilities 30-40% iOS, Social Networking 10-20% iOS, Finance 15-25% iOS.

facts.claim: Across more than 500 A/B tests, a preview video lifted conversion 20% to 35% on average, above 40% for games and about 20% for productivity
facts.source_title: App store conversion rate: how to improve it, with benchmarks
facts.excerpt: StoreMaven across 500+ A/B tests found a preview video lifts conversion 20-35% on average; games 35%, productivity 20%.

facts.claim: Preview videos beat static screenshots in 78% of tests, with a median conversion lift of 22%
facts.source_title: App store conversion rate: how to improve it, with benchmarks
facts.excerpt: SplitMetrics found preview videos outperformed static screenshots in 78% of cases, median conversion lift 22%.

facts.claim: Screenshots drive the install decision for up to 45% of users, and adding captions lifted conversion 25% on average
facts.source_title: 10 ways to improve app store conversion rates
facts.excerpt: Screenshots influence conversion more than any other element, deciding up to 45% of users; captions increased conversion 25% on average.

facts.claim: Health and fitness apps show a 4% to 8% impression-to-page-view rate and 25% to 40% page-view-to-install
facts.source_title: ASO Conversion Rate Benchmarks by App Category
facts.excerpt: Health & Fitness typically shows 4-8% IPV rate and 25-40% page view to install rate, with 1-3% impression to install.
